author: Mark Atwood
text:
SHIPPED the implementation half, 2026-11-25, in the commit above.

The bead's "STILL TO DO HERE" was written before the backend landed, so
most of it was already done by the time I got here: VtcBackend for
AgentChat has create_call, signal_call and export_media_secret over
Store::start_call, Store::send_call_signal and Store::media_secret;
mimiRoomId is served; the CallSignals WebSocket extension pushes each
VTCCallSignal from the store's change feed.

WHAT WAS ACTUALLY MISSING was the switch, and without it none of the
above was reachable by any client: VtcOptions::enabled defaults to false
(decision mimid-1wgh.119), vtc_backend::register registers nothing when
it is false, and mimid-agent had no setting to set it. So:

- `[jmap] vtc`, off by default, sets Options.vtc.
- The Session advertises urn:ietf:params:jmap:vtc when on, account-level
  properties as the draft puts them, absent entirely when off.
- supportsMimiKeyedCalls joins the capability (the jmap-chat-spec fb05ead
  addition), through VtcCapability's flattened extra map, so crate-jmap
  needed no change.
- The accepted `using` list is built at start rather than being the
  CAPABILITIES constant, so a client naming the capability while the
  surface is off gets RFC 8620 §3.3's unknownCapability instead of a
  method-level refusal it would have to interpret.

NOT DONE, and not this bead: the negotiation end to end. mimid-1wgh.114.10
is that test and this unblocks it.
